topic: update check: /checkVersion and per-updater response shaping (squirrel, electron-builder, tauri, manual)
hint: updaters.BuildResponse maps one internal response to different status codes/shapes per updater type (204 no_content, 302 redirect, tauri JSON); squirrel_windows additionally rewrites the RELEASES feed in latest.go.

topic: authentication: session JWT vs fns_ API tokens, AuthMiddleware, admin vs team principals
hint: JWTs bind to a principal document id + version (sessions revocable), not the username; API tokens (fns_) are accepted only for upload and carry allowed_apps.

topic: authorization: CheckPermission, team users, owner/tenant scoping
hint: Every app/channel/platform/arch is scoped by owner; team users resolve to their admin's owner via ResolveRequestOwner.
Both flows converge on FinalizeUpload (cache invalidation + feed materialization); public vs private bucket is chosen in BuildObjectPlacement by app visibility.

topic: private apps and /download: download modes, download tokens, access gate
hint: Denied reads return the same not-found as nonexistent apps; private apps are never cached and cannot use feed updaters or cdn_edge.

topic: Redis response cache, CDN edge publishing and cache invalidation
hint: cache key is owner-scoped; CDN epoch counter in Redis lets an upload invalidate in-flight CDN publishes.

topic: Sparkle and Velopack feeds: parsing, materialization into storage, dynamic feed endpoint
hint: Feeds are regenerated per (channel, platform, arch) tuple after upload (FeedTuple) and written to storage; velopack also has a live /velopack/:owner/:app/:platform/:arch/*feed route.

topic: TUF (The Update Framework) integration: bootstrap, metadata signing, artifact publish, online bumper
hint: Enabled only with TUF_ENABLED; state is in Redis/Mongo; feed artifacts are excluded from TUF targets; online roles are re-signed by a 5-minute goroutine guarded by a Redis tick lock.

topic: crash/event reports ingestion: report keys, group hashing, rate limits
hint: Only registered when REPORTS_ENABLED; auth is a per-app report key (Bearer) not the JWT; rate limiting fails open on Redis errors.

topic: telemetry: client usage stats in Redis (X-Device-ID, beacon, lua script)
hint: gated by ENABLE_TELEMETRY via telemetryMiddleware; stats are logged from the update-check path via logStatsToRedis.

topic: MongoDB layer and migrations: AppRepository, collections, embedded JSON migrations
hint: migrations are embedded JSON run via `faynoSync migrate up|down`; a pre-check aborts on duplicate app versions before the unique index migration.
